meta.name: Ethos
meta.description: A group of unique characters from dramatically different socio-cultural backgrounds meet in startling circumstances in the vibrant and colorful city of Istanbul, some by chance and some by force of will.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Afflicted by fainting spells, part-time cleaner Meryem confides in psychologist Peri - but she's reluctant to reveal one detail.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Ruhiye's condition deteriorates under Yasin's maltreatment. Peri crosses paths with Melisa. Meryem broaches a sensitive subject with Peri.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: After Ruhiye's upsetting dream, Yasin encounters Hayrunnisa, the hodja's daughter. Melisa asks Peri to face her biases. Gülbin catches Sinan unawares.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Meryem tells Peri about her star-struck encounter. Tensions come to a head between Gülbin and her sister. Yasin orders Meryem to stop visiting Peri.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: A suspicious Meryem questions Yasin about Hayrunnisa, who grapples with guilt in the wake of tragedy. Ruhiye, Yasin and Meryem head for the village.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Gülbin ends her sessions with Peri, who reaches a breaking point. Ruhiye revisits a dark chapter in her past. An unwelcome figure follows Burcu.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: A connection grows between Hilmi and Meryem. At Semiha's house, Ruhiye makes an earth-shattering revelation.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Peri talks to Meryem about repressed emotions. Ruhiye and Yasin make amends. Hayrunnisa sets off on her own path.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Struggling with his past actions and emotions, police chief Muzaffer decides to see a psychiatrist. Meryem and Peri reunite in the therapy room.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Meryem shares her worries with Peri about her husband's new online venture. Peri grapples with confidentiality as Meryem probes beyond her reach.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Muzaffer tells Peri about his bond with the object his late wife longed to own. Meanwhile, pregnant Meryem is distressed about Hilmi's predicament.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Amid a sudden upheaval in her personal life, a desperate Meryem tries to reach Muzaffer any way she can. Sadık confronts his father about the past.
